$Use \sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1 to obtain a function of sine only$ — M1

$Factor and obtain \frac{1-\sin\theta}{1+\sin\theta}$ — A1

Answer given: factors must be shown.

parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use part (i): $2-2\sin\theta=1+\sin\theta, so \sin\theta=\frac13$ — M1

$Uses part (i) to obtain \sin\theta=k.$

$\theta=19.5^\circ$ — A1

$\theta=160.5^\circ$ — A1 FT

Follow-through from an error in $19.5^\circ$.

$Allow 0.340 rad (0.3398 rad) and 2.80(2) rad, or 0.108\pi rad and 0.892\pi rad, for A1 only. Extra answers in the range lose the second A1 if gained for 160.5^\circ.$
